entry.digest: Messages and attributes common to Jitter Geometry objects

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: async
attributes.digest: Enable asyncronous geometry processing
attributes.description: Enables asyncronous geometry processing (default = 1). When enabled, geometry processing happens in a background thread. Changing the value ofwill change that value for all geometry operators bound to that context.

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: bypass
attributes.digest: Bypass geometry processing
attributes.description: Bypass geometry processing (default = 0). When enabled geometry input is passed on to the next geometry operator in the graph unmodified.

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: enable
attributes.digest: Enable geometry operator toggle
attributes.description: Enables the geometry operator (default = 1). When disabled, no geometry is processed or output.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Output geometry for generator operators. Other operator types ignore this message.

messages.name: cancel
messages.description: Attempts to cancel any geometry processing currently active in the operator.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: Clears and resets the geometry operator.

messages.name: output
messages.description: Output geometry for generator operators. Other operator types ignore this message.
